draft.shortGloss: to send; to steer, to drive

notes: Sturen has two very common meanings: sending something (like a message or a package) and steering a vehicle or bicycle.
Do not confuse sturen (to send/steer) with wandelen (to walk) or reizen (to travel).

senses.definition: To cause something to go or be taken to a destination; to dispatch a message or package.

examples.text: Ik zal je een email sturen vanavond.
examples.translation: I will send you an email tonight.
examples.emotion: casual and reassuring, promising to follow up

senses.definition: To guide or control the direction of a vehicle, bicycle, or boat.

examples.text: Het is lastig om deze oude fiets goed te sturen.

examples.emotion: focused and a little strained while handling a stubborn bike
